en.title: ADHDFlow — Privacy Policy / Terms of Use

privacy.sub: ADHDFlow · ONOUR IMPRAM VENTURES LTD · Last updated 14 September 2026

cards.html:
Your tasks, steps, time boxes and settings are stored only on your device. They are not uploaded, not backed up by us and not readable by us. Deleting the app deletes them; Export gives you a copy first if you want one.

Your language and workday hours are stored the same way and never leave the device.

Subscriptions are handled by RevenueCat, which works with Apple and Google to confirm what you have bought. RevenueCat receives an anonymous identifier for your installation and the purchase history attached to it. It does not receive your tasks or your plan.

Payment itself happens in the App Store or Google Play. We never see your card details.

The free version shows one banner in one place: the Report tab. There is no advertising on the Today screen, in the focus timer, in the task wizard, in the calendar, in insights, in settings or on the subscription screen.

Ads are served by Google AdMob, which may use your device advertising identifier to choose them. On iOS the system asks your permission first, and declining is a complete answer: the app works the same either way. Subscribing removes all advertising.

Reminders are scheduled on your device and never pass through a server. They are off until you turn them on, respect the quiet hours you set, and can be switched off in the app or in your system settings at any time.

There is no analytics tool in this app. We do not track which tasks you add, how many boxes you complete, or when you work. There are no accounts, so there is nothing to sign in to and nothing to leak.
This app is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from them.

terms.sub: ADHDFlow · ONOUR IMPRAM VENTURES LTD · Last updated 14 September 2026

cards.html:
ADHDFlow offers a monthly and an annual subscription. The price shown on the subscription screen is the price you pay, in your own currency, and it is the price the store charges. If a free trial is offered on the annual plan, the store's purchase screen states its length before you confirm; you can cancel during the trial and pay nothing.

Subscriptions renew automatically at the end of each period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends.

You can cancel at any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings. Cancelling stops the next renewal; it does not end the period you have already paid for, and you keep everything until that period runs out. The subscription screen has a Manage button that takes you straight there.

It removes advertising, opens every breakdown template, lifts the daily box limit, extends insights to four weeks, and lets the weekly report be shared and exported. Nothing you have already planned is ever behind it: your tasks and history stay yours whether you subscribe or not, and they stay if you cancel.
Refunds are handled by Apple and Google under their own policies, not by us. We cannot issue them directly, but we will not stand in the way of one.

ADHDFlow is a planning tool for your workday. It is not a medical device, it does not diagnose ADHD, and it is not a substitute for a clinician's advice or treatment. Decisions about medication or care belong with a qualified professional.

The app is provided as it is. We work to keep it reliable, but we cannot promise that it will always be available or free of errors, and it is not designed for situations where a missed reminder could cause harm.

This app is published by ONOUR IMPRAM VENTURES LTD (Company No. 17429906, registered in England and Wales), 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom. Questions about this policy: {{EMAIL}}

en.title: Kinlore — Memory Book — Privacy Policy / Terms of Use

privacy.sub: Kinlore — Memory Book · Last updated: 27 September 2026

cards.html:
Your book — every page, name and setting — is stored only on this device. Kinlore has no account, no server and no analytics, and never sends your writing anywhere.

Export and Share hand the text to the app you choose; from that moment it is that app's copy, under that app's rules.

Kinlore Premium is a single purchase through Google Play or the App Store. Payment is handled entirely by the store; Kinlore never sees your card.

To know whether the purchase belongs to this installation, Kinlore uses RevenueCat, which stores an anonymous identifier (shown as your Support ID in You) and the purchase record. No name, e-mail or other personal data is attached to it.

The free version shows ads from Google AdMob: a banner on the Book tab and, now and then, a full-screen ad after a page is bound — never while you write. To show, measure and limit ads and to prevent fraud, Google AdMob collects your device's advertising ID, your IP address (from which Google derives an approximate location), device and app information, diagnostic data such as crash and performance logs, and which ads you see and tap, and shares them with Google for advertising, analytics and fraud prevention. If you are in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, Google's consent form (User Messaging Platform) asks you first and you can refuse personalised ads; non-personalised ads still use this technical data, but not a profile of you. Premium removes every ad. Nothing you write is ever shared with an advertiser.
No profiling of your writing, no location, no contacts, no microphone. Notifications, if you turn them on, are scheduled on the phone itself and carry only the next prompt.

Kinlore is made for adults writing for the people they love and is not directed at children. To show, measure and limit ads and to prevent fraud, the Google Mobile Ads SDK collects the following and shares it with Google: your device’s advertising ID; your IP address, from which Google derives an approximate location; device and app information such as model, operating system, language and app version; diagnostic data such as crash and performance logs; and which ads you were shown and whether you tapped them. Google uses this data for advertising, analytics and fraud prevention under its own privacy policy.

Publisher: ONOUR IMPRAM VENTURES LTD · Company No. 17429906 · registered in England and Wales · 71-75 Shelton Street, Covent Garden, London WC2H 9JQ, United Kingdom. Questions about this policy: {{EMAIL}}.
